project_name: US-EU US-EU Joint Merchant Acquisition Project
reason:
Situation & Task: For sellers already winning on TTS, expanding globally through TTS is the next growth path. The project aimed to build a stable cross-region mechanism that channels content-capable, US-proven sellers into EU12, UK and JP, expanding TTS's overall share of seller wallet. 
Action:
Cross-region pairing: Paired seven US industry teams with their EU counterparts, with weekly tracking and escalation to drive continuous improvement.
Issue-to-policy loop: Distilled 26 recurring EU-entry pain points into 3 root categories and 3 policy upgrades.
Result:
US top-tier (T5) pool: new-market sellable rate 32% → 61%, outreach coverage 52% → 100%.
On track to attract T3/T4 sellers in Q3; Sellable HIPO projected to double vs. 2025.
Cross-region information routing upgraded, enabling two-way seller expansion in Q4.

EMEA Live Auction brought a new Live commerce format to EU and UK markets in H1 2026, moving from zero baseline to rapid scaling within two quarters and establishing auction as a new growth driver for Live in EMEA.
The impact was visible across the region. In both markets, auction GMV quickly grew to account for a meaningful share of total Live GMV and became a significant driver of overall GMV growth, with month-over-month growth accelerating sharply through Q2. The auction model also proved more efficient than standard Live across key metrics — GMV per hour, orders per hour, GPM and conversion rate — pointing to a format that delivers not just incremental volume but higher-quality growth.
Behind this was close collaboration across functions like strategy, BPO, operations, Product, GnE and etc. From benchmark research and target merchant mapping to product alignment and market execution, teams worked across compliance, payments, seller fulfilment and rollout needs to enable simultaneous launch and rapid iteration in both markets — turning auction from an early strategic priority into a repeatable operating model for regional growth.

EU8 Market Launch completed TikTok Shop Europe’s largest single-wave market expansion to date, with eight markets launched in parallel across Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Czech Republic, Austria, Greece, Portugal and Hungary. The project required close collaboration across Product, Operations, GNE, Logistics, UG, Data Science, Data/Algo, PIPO, Tech, Design, Legal and Compliance to align localisation, onboarding, payments, logistics and governance into one coordinated launch approach.
Beyond the scale of expansion, the project showed disciplined execution under complexity. Cross-functional teams worked through a shared mechanism to improve coordination, manage dependencies and resolve issues quickly. During UAT, all identified issues were resolved on time, and no P0 issue occurred during Pilot, supporting a stable and controlled rollout across markets.
The project also delivered clear early business results. C-side daily GMV reached 430% of target, launch-day GMV reached 625% of target, and long-tail markets achieved 139% of GMV target despite having no local merchant supply. EU8 also provided a more repeatable model for future multi-market launches, showing how teams can expand at pace while staying aligned on quality, readiness and execution.
